content.title: Delhi High Court Sets Aside Centre's Order Cancelling FCRA Licence of NGO
content.caption: The Delhi High Court overturned the Centre's decision to cancel the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) registration certificate of the NGO Socio Legal Information Centre (SLIC).
